item.text: I’m checking direct 2024 sources for how Scholz actually moved the state, coalition, and ministries behind his program, then I’ll weigh that against the late-year coalition collapse and implementation limits.

item.text:
Bottom line: mixed. Scholz clearly translated parts of his program into state action in 2024 through joint budgeting, technocratic staffing, regulatory timetables, and security-sector coordination. But the late-2024 coalition collapse and no-confidence vote show that he could not sustain a stable governing coalition or fully mobilize it through year-end.

### Evidence For
- [National Security Strategy](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356) | Federal Government | 14 Jun 2023, operative in 2024 | Scholz described a “systematic overall approach” covering diplomacy, police, civil protection, cyber security, supply chains, and pandemic prevention, with all government levels cooperating. This is strong evidence of mobilizing the state apparatus around a chosen program. | 8B.3, 8B.1, 8B.2
- [Summer press conference with Federal Chancellor Scholz](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/service/archive/chancellor-summer-press-conference-2024-2301040) | Federal Government | 24 Jul 2024 | Scholz said the draft budget was jointly determined and that 49 measures would be implemented through the growth initiative, including infrastructure, welfare-state stabilization, more Bundeswehr funding, and Ukraine support. This is direct evidence of coalition and bureaucracy mobilization. | 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Kukies appointed finance minister on Scholz’s proposal](https://www.bundespraesident.de/SharedDocs/Termine/DE/Frank-Walter-Steinmeier/2024/11/241107-Entlassungen-Ernennung-Minister.html) | Bundespräsident | 7 Nov 2024 | After Lindner’s dismissal, Scholz secured a formal appointment of Jörg Kukies under Article 64. The move was a constitutional staffing decision aimed at crisis management, not informal patronage. | 8B.3, 8B.2
- [AI and 5G timetables](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2307122) | Bundesregierung | 13 Oct 2024 | Scholz tied the EU AI Act and 5G security to a safer investment environment and fixed timetables for removing risky components. This shows program translation into concrete regulatory sequencing. | 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Bundeswehr mission review](https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/en/newsroom/news/2664958-2664958) | Federal Foreign Office / Federal Ministry of Defence | 26 Jun 2024 | The government carried out its first overarching evaluation of ongoing Bundeswehr missions using uniform criteria and identified improvement needs, including better civilian-military coordination and more realistic goals. That is evidence of bureaucratic coordination and correction. | 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Cabinet traceability reforms](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572) | Bundesregierung | 6 Mar 2024 | The cabinet adopted the “executive footprint” and “synopsis” to make draft laws and outside influence more traceable. This is a concrete institutional mechanism for implementing and auditing the governing program. | 8B.3, 8B.2

### Evidence Against
- [Germany’s ruling coalition crumbles](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936) | Reuters | 6 Nov 2024 | Reuters reported that Scholz’s firing of Lindner collapsed the coalition and triggered political chaos. This is strong evidence that the coalition machinery was no longer being effectively mobilized. | 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Scholz calls for cool heads to pull Germany out of political crisis](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/german-voters-and-opposition-keep-heat-on-scholz-for-early-election-3710828) | Reuters | 8 Nov 2024 | Scholz was reduced to asking parties to agree on which laws could still pass and denied trying to force through his own agenda. That reads more like crisis containment than effective coalition mobilization. | 8B.3, 8B.2
- [German Chancellor Scholz loses no-confidence vote, paving way for election](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/german-chancellor-scholz-loses-no-confidence-vote-paving-way-for-election-3773234) | Reuters | 16 Dec 2024 | Parliament withdrew confidence by a wide margin, confirming that Scholz had lost the governing majority needed to drive his program. This is direct counterevidence on effective mobilization. | 8B.3
- [Bundestag questions on the 49 measures](https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-1034192) | Deutscher Bundestag | 17 Dec 2024 | Parliament was still asking how many of the 49 measures were actually implemented and what growth effect to expect. The program existed, but its operational traction was still contested. | 8B.3, 8B.2
- [Taurus leak becomes security incident](https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c) | AP | 4 Mar 2024 | The defense ministry treated the intercepted Taurus call as a security incident and had to investigate and tighten procedures. That is a real command-and-control failure inside the security apparatus. | 8B.3

### Search Gap
I found no strong evidence of a durable, personal ruling network or party machine that stayed cohesive through 2024. The best positive evidence is technocratic and institutional, while the main negative is that coalition authority broke down late in the year, limiting how far the program could be carried.
